task_metadata.profile_switch_profile_note: Pre-switch path: fast, shallow, and early-closure friendly. These tasks reward compact evidence chains and tolerate earlier stop decisions.

profile_switch_stage_behavior.stage1: Fast grounding path: do the minimum identity and line grounding needed for downstream execution.
profile_switch_stage_behavior.stage2: Fast resolution path: stabilize the customer and line quickly without speculative extra validation.
profile_switch_stage_behavior.stage3: Shallow diagnosis path: validate only the highest-yield blocker families and leave long-tail branches unopened.
profile_switch_stage_behavior.stage4: Fast repair path: act only on clear blocker evidence and avoid long precondition chains.
profile_switch_stage_behavior.stage5: Fast closure path: use a compact verification floor and close quickly once a defensible local action is supported.

task_metadata.profile_switch_profile_note: Post-switch path: deeper reasoning and repair-precondition completion matter more than route labels or archetypes. These tasks reward fuller evidence chains and cautious closure.
task_metadata.profile_switch_bucket_note: Post-switch deep-path bucket where deeper reasoning, fuller verification, and cautious closure should pay off.

profile_switch_stage_behavior.stage1: Grounding remains compact, but the post-switch path starts preserving enough structure for later deep verification.
profile_switch_stage_behavior.stage2: Deep path entry: establish a sturdier account and line evidence chain before diagnosis widens.
profile_switch_stage_behavior.stage3: Deep diagnosis path: keep high-risk APN, roaming, SIM, and downstream blocker families open until decisive evidence resolves them.
profile_switch_stage_behavior.stage4: Verification-heavy repair path: complete blocker-specific repair preconditions before mutation and prefer supported repair subsets over blanket escalation.
profile_switch_stage_behavior.stage5: Cautious terminal path: verify decisive post-repair evidence, distinguish local evidence gaps from true external/manual blockers, and close only when the evidence chain supports the final action.
